package.name: x30_odometry
package.description: The LiDAR-inertial odometry of the X30 (the ROS Noetic port of dharma_odometry): FAST-LIO2 on the merged Livox LiDARs and the body IMU behind a start gate that waits for a still and level IMU, and a monitor that says when the odometry can no longer be trusted (stale, jumps, restarts, z drift, a tilted start, a speed mismatch with the leg odometry) and how far the robot went.
